# swiftlang/swift#94511: on Linux, ThreadSanitizer cannot see the acquire in
# Synchronization.Mutex's non-inlined slow path (`_lockSlow`, plain-futex),
# so it reports false races between withLock bodies on contended Mutexes.
# The frame below is an access inside such a withLock. Remove the entry once
# the toolchain includes the upstream fix, swiftlang/swift#94425 (and its
# XFAIL test, swiftlang/swift#94307).
# The routing lock: every access to `Routing` runs under `routing.withLock`,
# and those closures carry the nested type identifier in their mangled
# symbols (`...7Routing...`). This covers enqueue, the migration cut, and
# releaseStagedJobs without matching the rest of the class.
race:Routing
